title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
script:
Amazon SVP Panos Panay says your apps might eventually disappear.
He envisions ambient AI devices that anticipate your needs automatically.
The goal is software that runs entirely in the background.
Panay detailed this vision yesterday at the TechCrunch Disrupt conference.
He thinks we should move past the current interface limits.
These devices would stop users from needing manual commands.
Would you trust an AI to navigate your digital life?
